## Changes

- Add `markdown-width` to limit Markdown lines to 300 characters by default; configure the limit with `--max-chars`.
- Raise the default directory file limit from 15 to 20.
- Allow consuming repositories to override the bundled Oxlint policy with a root Oxlint configuration.
- Make `unbold` opt-in in the example configuration.

Copy the updated `example_conf/prek.toml` when upgrading to enable the new hook and adopt the default changes.
